arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: David Walbert argued for Georgia. He cited six decades of integration policy. He said the new map fits this trend.
John Braden argued for opponents. He claimed the map is a calculated scheme. He said it moves Black voters to weaken their districts.
